title: ATB overseer-decision-record
description: The accountability artifact an OVERSEER (Claude Code or Codex) must emit for every agent-affecting decision — a choice to rewrite (or deliberately NOT rewrite) one of a small agent's rewritable layers (identity/skill/tool/context). It makes the overseer charter BITE: the completeness-reconciliation check (tools/decision_record_check.py) binds every durable agent-layer git change to one of these records, and flags any layer change with no linked record. This schema validates SHAPE only; soundness of the decision stays with Codex + the overseer + Korab (doer != certifier). Schema-valid != sound.

id.description: Stable, unique record id (e.g. odr-20260620T120000Z-coder-contract-shape). Referenced verbatim by the `Decision-Record: <id>` git trailer on the resulting profiles-repo commit (bidirectional binding).

created_ts.description: UTC timestamp the record was authored (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

target_agent.description: The agent or actor whose layer the decision concerns — a crew agent (coder/qa/main/dreamer/research) or an improver pointed UP the stack (codex/overseer/system).

grounding_pack_id.description: The grounding-pack id (tools/grounding_pack.py output) the decision was grounded in — the charter's reflex #1. Required even for a no_change/defer decision (you grounded that too).

memory_refs.description: Memory slugs/links consulted (operating thesis, prior promotions, identity-first law, corpus state, ...). At least one — a decision made from recall, not memory, violates the charter.

log_refs.description: Event/log references consulted (events.jsonl ids, feedback/round-N.md paths, gate-held diffs). May be empty for a purely proactive decision.

detector_source_refs.description: The EXISTING-detector artifacts that triggered this (coach lesson refs, Improvement-Feeder class ids, gate-held event ids). May be empty for a proactive decision; a recurrence-driven one should cite >=1.

layer_considered.description: Which refinement surface the decision concerns. 'none' is valid only with decision=no_change/defer.

decision.description: layer-rewrite = a durable change was applied (MUST end with a linked profiles-repo commit + commit_hash); no_change = considered and deliberately left as-is; defer = postponed (set expiry).

certifier.description: Who certified the decision, independent of the doer (e.g. 'codex', 'korab', 'codex+korab'). doer != certifier, pointed UP the stack.

status.description: Lifecycle. A layer-rewrite reaches 'applied'/'certified' only once the commit exists and commit_hash is filled (the completeness check binds this).

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of the decision (renders in the audit digest).

commit_hash.description: The resulting profiles-repo commit SHA for an applied layer-rewrite (the back-half of the bidirectional binding). Absent for proposed/no_change/defer. Hex, 7-64 chars.

overfit_analysis.description: For a layer-rewrite: the anti-over-fit reasoning (which corpus envelope, why this is a general agent weakness not monoculture residue, the bounded wording). Recommended; the PROMOTE governance enforces its substance.

expiry.description: For decision=defer: the date after which the deferral is stale and must be revisited (no silent indefinite defer).

supersedes.description: The id of a prior record this one revisits/replaces, if any.

allOf.$comment: An applied/certified layer-rewrite MUST carry its commit_hash (the back-half of the binding).
A proposed/reverted layer-rewrite has no live applied commit, so it MUST NOT cite one — else an uncertified record could back a real change (commit_hash present <=> applied/certified).
A no_change / defer decision did not change a layer, so it MUST NOT cite a commit.
A defer MUST set an expiry (no silent indefinite deferral).
layer_considered=none is coherent only when nothing was rewritten.
